meta.name: V4 Launch R01
meta.objective: Execute the first live V4 launch loop: apply Gilardi and Zheng bundles into Convex, register paper-audit packages, create and launch baseline canary experiments, monitor their behavior, and write explicit promotion gates for moving from canaries to full headline matrix instantiation.

compile.baseHint: Use the locked V4 spec, the terminal implementation-readiness state, and the hardened infra/runtime baseline. Do not reopen design work; execute the first live setup loop.
taskSignals: Local Gilardi and Zheng import bundles already exist.
Live Convex, Railway worker, and provider routing are already healthy.
The remaining work is control-plane creation, canary execution, and monitoring/promotion logic.
The first bounded run should stay narrow: baseline canaries first, then explicit promotion gates.
notes: Keep the first launch loop bounded to Gilardi baseline and Zheng baseline canaries.
Use existing scripts/v4 live paths rather than building a new launcher unless a real blocker appears.

stopConditions: Stop when live Gilardi and Zheng baseline canaries are created, at least one canary path is run and monitored successfully, and promotion gates for matrix instantiation are explicit.
Stop early only for real external blockers such as provider failures, unavailable Railway/Convex, or broken live control-plane surfaces.

budget.primary: Prefer narrow baseline canaries over broad cohort launch in R01.
budget.secondary: Only patch code when a live canary exposes a concrete blocker.
